scope: Direct complete-original-body prerequisite research of the first thirteen Vtmocanu originals. All 3305 original lines were read as inert data; initially truncated team-document ranges were subsequently read completely in smaller guarded chunks. No described team, timer, permission change, desktop app, diagnostic helper or build was activated.
linked_reference_caveat: Only original bodies were reviewed. Role libraries, sync implementation and tests, workflow templates, permission wrapper, settings helpers and schemas, platform references and actual target projects require separate review. Source anecdotes, runtime-version claims, performance figures and broad safety claims are not independently established outcomes.

sources.workflow: Discover a real project's actual gate commands and environments, generate or synchronize role definitions while preserving project-specific tails, then orchestrate scoped implementation and immutable-revision verification with durable handoffs and explicit release boundaries.
sources.explicit_prerequisites: A real project, reviewed roles library, manifest template, sync helper and regression tests, compatible YAML dependency and exact selected host team protocol are required. Actual team execution requires separately authorized agents and an isolated runtime; source-specific model handling and measured anecdotes require current independent evidence.
sources.offline_assessment: A selected actual role-sync, frontmatter, byte-preserving tail or gate-discovery bug can be offline using genuine public project artifacts and stubbed team responses. Standard-library Python alone lacks the stated YAML parser and agent platform. No source authorization, model-selection advice, history rewrite, team-state repair or shared-system cleanup was adopted.
sources.independent_verifier_needed: Verify content as well as versions, exact CRLF and tail preservation, custom and malformed file refusals, unique backups and explicit partial-coverage statuses. Check gate commands are truly non-fixing and match real environments, revisions and writer ownership, and actual task completion rather than vanished task lists or green narratives. Team-generation success, verified code and published release are separate endpoints.

sources.workflow: Represent an actual explicitly bounded autonomy grant, verify enrollment and exact-artifact co-signatures, decide only allowed recoverable work and persist holds, corrections and revocation before stopping owned scheduling.
sources.explicit_prerequisites: A real documented grant and item inventory, reviewed timer and peer protocols, exact authenticated sender and artifact identities, independent state-transition rules and any authorized scheduler are required. Real merges, spending or external effects need their separate permissions; peer agreement cannot create them.
sources.offline_assessment: A selected actual grant-ledger, duplicate activation, deadline or decision-classification bug can be offline with genuine public implementation and inert protocol records. It does not establish a running watcher, restored state or real delegation authority. No schedule, buddy binding, grant or autonomous external action was created.
sources.independent_verifier_needed: Check earliest termination, duplicate and changed grant IDs, sender authentication versus payload claims, revocation-before-activation, exact-head co-sign validity, ownership, disagreement holds and transparent delivery failure. Verify timer cancellation and held-state persistence under actual restart semantics; a return report or saved deadline alone does not establish that authority ended or monitoring continued.

sources.workflow: Determine the real forge and requested generate or advise mode, derive the pipeline from actual project automation and explicit policy and check pinned dependencies, least privilege, cache scope and required-job order.
sources.explicit_prerequisites: A real public project and CI contract, reviewed generate, security and speed references, exact compatible forge workflow schema and runner tools and independent expected job behavior are required. Live CI or repository-setting claims need authorized sandbox access; a remote host name alone may not identify a custom forge.
sources.offline_assessment: A selected actual workflow parsing, cache-key, dependency-DAG or permission-scoping code task can be offline on genuine public configurations. It does not establish a real CI run, repository policy or registry visibility. No workflow, runner, action, package or account setting was changed.
sources.independent_verifier_needed: Verify exact action identities and trust scopes, required versus skipped gates, source-aware output-cache validity, safe cancellation and genuine project-command equivalence. Distinguish prerequisite builds from premature publication and authenticate real service properties independently; a tokenless failure, matching grep or absent linter cannot establish a secure or green pipeline.

sources.workflow: Analyze an actual requested permission without executing the operation, select the correct scoped configuration and evaluate effective rule ordering and wrapper behavior with preserved unrelated rules.
sources.explicit_prerequisites: A real bounded permission request, actual released Dippy parser and wrapper, reviewed example configuration and hook protocol, exact host mode and independently specified expected decisions are required. Personal configuration paths in the source are illustrative context, not authorized study inputs or portable defaults.
sources.offline_assessment: A selected actual rule parser, wrapper decision filter or configuration-editor bug can be offline against isolated public fixtures and stubbed host events after helper review. It does not establish the real host permission state or authorize disabling a guard. No installed wrapper, marker file, configuration or protected command was accessed or changed.
sources.independent_verifier_needed: Check exact last-match and global/project precedence, complete command and path-token matching, allow/ask/deny and afterthought handling across wrapper states and explicit escalation markers. Test invalid configurations and missing-file behavior without executing target actions, and verify readback preserves unrelated settings. Valid JSON or an empty hook response is not proof of effective denial or user approval.

sources.workflow: Target the real browser surface, verify navigation, use fresh interactive element references, perform the requested interaction and confirm its actual resulting state before further actions.
sources.explicit_prerequisites: An actual public browser task and page, reviewed CLI, element-reference and session protocols, compatible cmux application and WKWebView and independent page-state assertions are required. Authenticated work needs a separately authorized test identity. Unsupported CDP facilities must not be assumed available.
sources.offline_assessment: A selected actual CLI result-parser or stale-reference state-machine bug can be offline using genuine public protocol artifacts and stubbed browser responses. A true page interaction needs a compatible isolated browser, absent from standard-library Python. No page, session or desktop surface was opened or acted on.
sources.independent_verifier_needed: Verify surface and workspace identity, actual navigation rather than blank-state waiting, fresh references after DOM changes, exact input readback, bounded waits and truthful unsupported or script-error handling. Independently check the requested page outcome rather than success text or a snapshot alone; stubbed responses cannot establish real form submission or authenticated state.

sources.workflow: Choose the actual app, project, dock or terminal surface, preserve existing configuration, apply only the requested schema-backed change and verify its registered entrypoint and rendered behavior.
sources.explicit_prerequisites: A real customization brief and released configuration artifacts, reviewed examples, settings helper and schema, exact cmux and Ghostty ownership and independent expected merge and UI behavior are required. Full desktop validation needs the compatible app in an isolated test environment.
sources.offline_assessment: A selected actual JSONC merge, action-reference or project-override defect can be offline using genuine public code and data. It does not prove a live reload or a working menu, shortcut, terminal or remote session. No user preference, dock control, custom command or app configuration was changed.
sources.independent_verifier_needed: Check exact scope and override precedence, action-to-command references, duplicate keys, preserved unrelated sections and explicit removals of default UI buttons. Verify real reload and chosen entrypoint behavior independently from parsing, and keep secret-bearing commands out of configuration. A valid example layout alone does not establish usable customization.

sources.workflow: Collect minimal actual CLI, socket, settings and integration-status evidence, distinguish missing capabilities from failed checks and rerun the narrowly relevant check only after an authorized fix.
sources.explicit_prerequisites: A real bounded reported symptom, reviewed bundled diagnostic and settings helpers, compatible app/socket protocol and independent expected diagnostic output and redaction rules are required. Actual session restoration additionally requires a genuine permitted test session and executable, not personal history.
sources.offline_assessment: A selected actual diagnostic-output classifier, redactor or helper-discovery defect can be offline with genuine released implementation and stubbed command records. It cannot prove a live healthy socket, installed hook or restored agent. No diagnostic script, notification, hook setup, session store or credential was accessed or executed.
sources.independent_verifier_needed: Check failure and unsupported states remain explicit, missing identifiers do not become false health claims and support summaries omit raw sensitive configuration and session contents. Independently distinguish file metadata, registered integration and actual resume behavior. A present store or successful settings parse is not an end-to-end restoration result.

sources.workflow: Resolve the actual action and requested reset semantics, snapshot exact prior values, modify only chosen binding paths and verify recognized configuration and real focus-dependent behavior.
sources.explicit_prerequisites: A real shortcut request, reviewed settings helper, action schema and defaults implementation, exact app version and independent shortcut parsing and activation contracts are required. System-wide hotkeys also require actual macOS reservation and enable-state evidence.
sources.offline_assessment: A selected actual chord parser, override merge or exact rollback defect can be offline on genuine public code and settings fixtures. It does not establish a working global key or conflict-free desktop behavior. No shortcut, app preference or system hotkey was changed.
sources.independent_verifier_needed: Check single-stroke versus chord rules, numeric action families, null unbinding versus absent overrides, complete prior-value restoration and untouched unrelated keys. Independently test focus and browser collisions and separate file overrides from Settings UI values; helper validation checks supported keys, not every shortcut or actual system reservation.

sources.workflow: Open an actual Markdown artifact in the intended viewer surface and keep the displayed document current across writes and supported atomic file replacement, with explicit missing-file behavior.
sources.explicit_prerequisites: A real public Markdown document and viewer task, reviewed command and live-reload references, actual rendering and watcher implementation and compatible isolated app are required. An independent rendering and lifecycle verifier must state which features and reconnection window are binding.
sources.offline_assessment: A selected actual path-router, watcher or Markdown-processing defect can be offline using released public code and files. Standard-library Python does not provide the desktop viewer, and static content checks do not establish live reload. No plan, agent instruction file or actual viewer surface was created or modified.
sources.independent_verifier_needed: Verify correct caller and explicit workspace targeting, literal document content and supported structure, writes and atomic rename events, unavailable-file rendering and bounded reconnection versus reopen behavior. A present file, successful open command or screenshot does not establish later automatic updates or complete rendering support.

sources.workflow: Translate an actual requested preference to its authoritative recognized key, edit the intended JSONC file through the real helper and verify exact persisted value and app-consumed behavior.
sources.explicit_prerequisites: A real released settings helper and target configuration, reviewed authoritative key and action schemas, exact JSONC and fallback semantics and independently specified expected values are required. Full reload verification needs a compatible isolated cmux app; the helper's runtime dependencies need inspection.
sources.offline_assessment: A selected actual JSONC parser, atomic write, dotted-path or fallback-precedence bug can be offline with genuine public code and fixtures. It does not prove an application consumed the change. No global, legacy or project setting was read or changed.
sources.independent_verifier_needed: Check correct literal versus JSON value parsing, exact key and type bounds, preservation of unrelated non-settings sections and atomic failure behavior. Verify absent primary values against actual legacy and UI precedence; the original's generic unset-to-default claim must be reconciled with the separate shortcut original's UI-override caveat. Readback and valid keys alone do not prove reload or actual defaults.

sources.workflow: Anchor requested automation to the actual caller workspace, surface and socket, create or reuse only owned helper output and preserve unrelated user focus and sessions.
sources.explicit_prerequisites: An actual workspace task and released CLI/socket implementation, reviewed command reference, exact caller-identification and topology contracts and independently recorded expected routing are required. Full UI effects need a compatible isolated application and verified action ownership.
sources.offline_assessment: A selected actual identity-resolver, explicit-target command builder or topology planner can be offline on genuine public protocol artifacts. It does not prove non-disruptive GUI execution or actual tagged-app isolation. No workspace, pane, surface, key input, socket access mode or application reload was changed.
sources.independent_verifier_needed: Check caller environment precedence, explicit target IDs, focus flags, safe handling of missing context and no accidental focused-window fallback for mutations. Independently verify additive helper reuse, correct surface ownership and actual user focus before and after the operation. Successful CLI output does not prove that the correct workspace changed.

sources.workflow: Reconcile actual owned work and outstanding requirements, report precise tracked and unpushed state and remove only session-created unused artifacts whose complete work is independently preserved.
sources.explicit_prerequisites: A real session-owned artifact inventory and repository state, exact upstream and preservation evidence, ownership and usage records and independent closure criteria are required. Fresh remote preservation evidence may require authorized network access; no inferred ownership follows from a directory's presence.
sources.offline_assessment: A selected actual closure classifier or git-output parser can be offline with genuine public repository artifacts and stubbed remote state. It cannot prove current remote preservation or permit cleanup of a shared host. No branch, worktree, stash, clone, ref or directory was removed.
sources.independent_verifier_needed: Verify dirty, untracked, ignored and unpushed work, exact squash-head versus ancestry distinctions, active users and handoffs and the full outstanding-task inventory. Fail closed on missing ownership or remote evidence and verify any real approved removal individually; a clean tree or closure statement cannot establish task completion or safe deletion.

sources.workflow: Derive an actual project's runtime, build outputs, dependencies and entrypoint from code, preserve intentional existing behavior and produce a minimal build definition and context exclusions, then validate real build and application behavior in an authorized isolated runtime.
sources.explicit_prerequisites: A real public target and precise application contract, exact compatible base images and dependencies, reviewed build inputs and licenses and independent non-root, content and runtime verifiers are required. Multi-architecture claims require corresponding actual build evidence; Docker availability and cached authorized build materials are separate prerequisites.
sources.offline_assessment: A selected actual Dockerfile-analysis or context-selection code bug can be offline on genuine public artifacts. A real offline build requires all images and packages already available in the isolated runtime, absent from standard-library Python alone. No image, package, container or Docker setting was created, run or cleaned, and the known Docker blocker was not bypassed.
sources.independent_verifier_needed: Verify actual copied artifacts, runtime dependency closure, signals and app-specific readiness, required environment configuration without fake secrets, exact non-root behavior and claimed architectures. Reconcile root-owned executable advice with the broad chown example and mutable version tags with reproducibility requirements. An EXPOSE line, running process, optional skipped scan or short Dockerignore is not proof of a functioning secure deployment.

source_reader: Direct complete-original-body review; exact cohort selection, original hashes, line totals, disjoint IDs and citation bounds independently reconciled by parent.
status_scope: Only original-body prerequisites; linked references, concrete tasks and runtime evidence remain distinct.
